mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO rag_entity (name_norm, name_display, description, user_id, team_id) VALUES
(#{e.nameNorm}, #{e.nameDisplay}, #{e.description}, #{e.userId}, #{e.teamId})
ON CONFLICT (name_norm, user_id, COALESCE(team_id, -1)) DO UPDATE SET description = rag_entity.description || '\n' || EXCLUDED.description, name_display = rag_entity.name_display, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_entity SET degree = (SELECT count(*) FROM rag_chunk_entity WHERE entity_id = rag_entity.id), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rag_entity WHERE degree = 0 AND id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_entity SET community_stale = TRUE WHERE id IN #{id}
UPDATE rag_entity SET embedding = #{embedding,typeHandler=com.smart.rag.rag.mapper.VectorTypeHandler}::vector, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name_norm, name_display, description, user_id, team_id, degree, weak_tie_score, bridge_score, community_id, community_stale, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_entity WHERE description IS NOT NULL AND description != '' AND embedding IS NULL LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_entity e SET bridge_score = sub.distinct_communities, updated_at = NOW() FROM ( SELECT e0.id AS entity_id, COALESCE( count(DISTINCT e2.community_id) FILTER (WHERE e2.community_id IS NOT NULL AND e2.community_id <> e0.community_id), 0 ) AS distinct_communities FROM rag_entity e0 LEFT JOIN v_entity_neighbors vn ON vn.entity_id = e0.id AND vn.user_id = #{userId} AND (#{teamId} IS NULL AND vn.team_id IS NULL OR vn.team_id = #{teamId}) LEFT JOIN rag_entity e2 ON e2.id = vn.neighbor_id WHERE e0.user_id = #{userId} AND (#{teamId} IS NULL AND e0.team_id IS NULL OR e0.team_id = #{teamId}) GROUP BY e0.id ) sub WHERE e.id = sub.entity_id
UPDATE rag_entity SET community_stale = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (#{teamId} IS NULL AND team_id IS NULL OR team_id = #{teamId})
